highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap rendering performance and reduces parsing and shaping overhead.

breaking.title: Remove whitespace immediately after the color prefix
breaking.body: SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after # in six- or eight-digit input. Remove that inner whitespace before parsing; surrounding whitespace and case-insensitive hexadecimal input remain supported.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to milestone 151 without changing the native C API.
Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag, avoiding substring allocation and reducing parsing overhead.

Restores the optimized CPU path for scaled and tiled bitmaps that regressed after Skia m146. Color conversion and single-value premultiply/unpremultiply also avoid per-color native calls while preserving results.
Corrects malformed native text-resource cleanup, native-coordinate stencil tracking, preserve-mode stencil clearing, and resolve dirty tracking after failed work.

bullets.lead: Less shaping allocation and prompt image cleanup
bullets.detail: SKShaper reads glyph results through zero-copy spans, HarfBuzz UTF-8 string input uses pooled encoding, and subset image decoding promptly disposes an intermediate image when a new subset is returned.

Supplies Emscripten 5.0.6 native assets with the new exception-handling instructions required by .NET 11 preview 6 and later in this release. .NET 8, 9, and 10 retain their existing toolchain mappings.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets and cross-backend visual testing, and removed redundant WASM build warnings.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the Skia m151 line without managed API changes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations, and fixed malformed native text-resource cleanup. Color parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after #.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Restored CPU bitmap performance, optimized color math, and fixed intermediate subset-image cleanup. Added matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and exception handling, plus Ganesh stencil and resolve corrections.

harfbuzz_summary: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses pooled encoding, and Tag.Parse accepts ReadOnlySpan<char> without its former scratch-array work. HarfBuzz WebAssembly assets add the Emscripten 5.0.6 toolchain for .NET 11.

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.headline: Preview 1 opened the Skia m151 line without changing the managed API surface.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.headline: Preview 2 added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations, and corrected malformed native text cleanup.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.headline: The release candidate restored CPU bitmap performance, optimized color math, fixed subset-image cleanup, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and exception handling.

v4.151.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 promotes the release candidate to stable without additional collected changes.
